high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website new18.com. The headline reads: "Karisma Kapoor Awaits Ex-Husband Sunjay Kapur's Body As Funeral Hits Legal Roadblock: Report." The story is by Shrishti Negi and was published 12 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The article mentions that industrialist and polo enthusiast Sunjay Kapur, who was formerly married to actress Karisma Kapoor, passed away in London on Thursday after suffering a heart attack during a polo match. He was 53 years old. The text indicates that the funeral has encountered unexpected legal issues.
